title: Preregister the selector-by-context-size study
description:
## Scope

Compare zero-shot, five seed-fixed random balanced sets, a development-selected fixed global set, class prototypes, and per-target lexical retrieval. Use a balanced ladder starting at 1, 4, 16, and 64 examples per label (Emotion totals 6/24/96/384; AG News totals 4/16/64/256), subject to documented model limits. Keep wording, option order, candidate pool, and initial display rule fixed. Choose one primary fixed-budget selection contrast and one primary size contrast before collection; correct or clearly separate secondary comparisons.

## Definition of done

The committed plan specifies dataset-specific metrics (macro-F1 for imbalanced Emotion), repeated draws, exact target counts, development tuning/search budget, nested membership, paired target/draw inference, and a computed request matrix. It does not infer that selection matters more than size from a single-budget result.

comments.text: Native next-stage audit: one Jev model entails 20 random-balanced development trials (4 positive per-label sizes x 5 draws), or 8000 AG News / 12000 Emotion logical development decisions. Full one-order scoreboard is 33 conditions x 2000 targets = 66000 logical decisions per dataset (zero1 + random20 + prototype4 + retrieval4 + selected-global4); exact physical deduplication must be computed from the final frozen protocol and selected artifact. No live calls are authorized by these counts. The exact provider model/version, public transport/capability configuration and human-approved attempt ceilings remain to be frozen. Current nominal paired intervals are not a substitute for valid prespecified Holm inputs. Ordering is a subsequent study, before cross-model comparisons. No DSPy.
